title: 3 reasons you never have enough money
caption:
Reason one. You save what's left after spending, and nothing is ever left. Save first, on payday.
Reason two. Small subscriptions you forgot about keep charging every month.
Reason three. Interest on debt eats your income before you see it.

scenes.say: Why do you never seem to have enough money, even after payday?
